modalities.evidence: An MEG study (306-sensor Elekta Neuromag System)

output.population: Participants were all SCID interviewed to meet either control (CTL, non-depressed, n=38) or major depressive disorder (MDD, n=52) group criteria
output.summary: 306-sensor MEG recorded during a probabilistic selection reinforcement learning task, comparing SCID-interviewed non-depressed controls with participants meeting major depressive disorder criteria, studying the Reward Positivity.
